LeadsforgeAPIKeyCredential.title: Leadsforge API Key
LeadsforgeAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Leadsforge, open Usage → API & MCP and create an API key. Paste the key without the Bearer prefix. NoClick reads your enrichment jobs to check access. Search and enrichment can consume account credits; job creation returns immediately, so use the job status and results operations to poll later.
